name: codedp-bench-fc-cpt-v2
description: A benchmark for predicting CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) procedure codes from clinical or free-text inputs and for related code-completion tasks. It evaluates models' ability to map textual clinical descriptions to standardized procedure codes, typically framed as multi-label classification or ranking. Useful for assessing clinical NLP and automated medical coding systems.
evaluation_method: F1 (micro/macro), precision/recall and ranking metrics (precision@k, recall@k)
reputation: Niche dataset focused on medical coding research; limited public adoption outside clinical NLP and coding communities.
